name: Dwarves of Ulgrotha
description: Dwarves from another plane who built New Freedom and Morning Light and were trapped by Baron Sengir.

description_citations.text: "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dwarf-redcap feud on Eldraine boils over into the Assault on Delverhaugh.
timeline.quote: The feud boiled over in a massive food fight known as the Assault on Delverhaugh .

citation.text: "Dwarf", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir invades New Freedom, chases off the dwarves and turns Princess Irini into a vampire.
timeline.quote: even turned their princess Irini into a vampire whom he adopted as his daughter

citation.text: "Dwarf", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dwarves from another plane dig through a planar gate to Ulgrotha and found New Freedom and the castle Morning Light.
timeline.quote: a colony of Dwarves from another plane dug through a subterranean planar gate to Ulgrotha

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir, stranded after two planeswalkers duel, slays or undeads the dwarves and takes the castle.
timeline.quote: they found that all of their kin had been slain or turned into undead by the Baron
